name: Vegan Seaweed Floss – Pork Rib Flavor
summary: A vegan floss made from **natural seaweed** and **plant-based "pork rib"**, fragrant with lime leaves and toasted sesame. Nutty, savory and perfect with rice – **100% vegan, no preservatives**.
pitch: Vegan seaweed floss with lime leaves – just sprinkle on rice

proofs.title: Test report
proofs.org: AVATEK Center for Testing and Applied Science Consulting (ISO/IEC 17025)
proofs.scope: Per 100g: 490 kcal, protein 39.2g, fat 34.6g, sodium 1,666mg. Aflatoxin B1, total Aflatoxin and Salmonella not detected

proofs.title: Factory certified ISO 22000:2018
proofs.scope: Huong Sac Vegan Co., Ltd. (Hai Phong): production and trading of vegetarian foods

highlights: Ready to eat with rice, congee, sticky rice or bread

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text: Plant-based pork rib (80%), seaweed (12%), sesame, lime leaves, vegetable oil, vegan seasonings.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Rich in natural minerals from seaweed.
Provides plant protein and healthy fats.
Fragrant with lime leaves and toasted sesame; nutty and savory.

sections.title: How to use
sections.text: Enjoy straight from the jar with hot rice, congee, sticky rice, bread, rice balls or lunch boxes, or sprinkle over salads.

sections.title: Who it's for
sections.text: Vegetarians and vegans, people following a macrobiotic diet, anyone wanting more plant protein, older adults, students, office workers and families.

sections.title: Storage
items: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
Close tightly after use; best enjoyed within 7 days of opening.

faq.q: Is the seaweed floss with vegan ribs really vegan?
faq.a: Yes. It is **fully plant-based**: vegan ribs (80%), seaweed (12%), sesame, lime leaves, vegetable oil and vegan seasonings. No preservatives.

faq.q: What do I eat it with?
faq.a: Straight on hot rice, congee, sticky rice, bread, rice balls, lunch boxes or sprinkled over salad. Nutty and savoury with lime leaf and toasted sesame.

faq.q: Can children eat it? Is it salty?
faq.a: It suits the whole family, including students, older adults and vegetarians. Sodium is 1,200–1,800mg per 100g, so enjoy it in moderation as a side.
Two sizes: a **215g jar** and a **165g jar**.

faq.q: How do I store it after opening?
faq.a: Keep in a dry, cool place away from sunlight. Close tightly after each use; best within 7 days of opening.
